text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the Arima Kinen, Seiun Sky's grandfather comes to the academy to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being like a storm in human form, he leaves a strong first impression on me, and I can tell how much Seiun Sky loves him.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later while training, Special Week and Grass Wonder, who will also be racing in the Arima Kinen, stop by to offer their encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky tries to get them to spill their strategies for the upcoming race, but there's no getting past Grass Wonder's defenses. Things are getting more interesting in the lead-up to the race.
